classification.difficultyReason: Generalises distribution to two trinomials and represents all nine products in an explanatory diagram.

inlines.text: . Draw a diagram to illustrate your answer.

answer.short:
$ad+ae+af+bd+be+bf+cd+ce+cf$

Multiply every term in one bracket by every term in the other; the diagram has nine product regions.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}(a+b+c)(d+e+f)&=a(d+e+f)+b(d+e+f)+c(d+e+f)\\(a+b+c)(d+e+f)&=ad+ae+af+bd+be+bf+cd+ce+cf\end{align*}$$
The nine smaller rectangles represent the nine products.
